description: Check an agent before it gets a passport: the name, description, capabilities and endpoint, and a test of the endpoint (an MCP session that lists its tools, or one POST of a test task). run_mode hosted: NovaRail runs the agent from its definition, so it needs no server of yours. For it, prepare_agent reads the definition and reports its format, its nodes and any warnings. Writes nothing and never lists. Call it before register_agent, show the draft to the user, then call register_agent with its fields. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

capabilities.description: Up to 12 short words, each 1 to 40 characters.

definition.description: run_mode hosted only. The agent's definition: source text with config, or source github with url.

config.description: source text: the definition as text, JSON or YAML, at most 1 MB.

format.description: auto (the default), agentnet, claude, openai, langchain, crewai or custom.

url.description: source github: a github.com link to the definition file.

description.description: What it does, at most 1000 characters.

endpoint_url.description: The agent's public https URL, if it has one.

name.description: The agent's name, at most 80 characters.

protocol.description: How NovaRail calls the endpoint. auto tries MCP, then http.

run_mode.description: endpoint (the default): the agent runs on your own server. hosted: NovaRail runs it from its definition.

tool_argument.description: For an MCP endpoint: the tool's argument that takes the task.

tool_name.description: For an MCP endpoint: the tool to call.

visibility.description: The visibility register_agent will get. run_mode hosted: private (the default) or unlisted.

name: prepare_agent
title: Prepare an agent
